name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs voice app — generate natural-sounding speech from text (TTS) and make phone calls with a conversational voice agent (outbound calls via Twilio, call transcripts and analysis, ConvAI agent configuration).

events.description: A voice call ended: post-call transcription webhook. Payload nested under `data` AND flattened to top-level aliases (conversationId, transcriptSummary, callSuccessful...) at dispatch. Signed with the workspace webhook secret.

payload.conversationId: string — flat alias of data.conversation_id (added by Teros at dispatch; use for subscription rules and Automate filters)

events.description: An outbound call was just dispatched by the `outbound-call` tool. Emitted locally by the MCA (not by an ElevenLabs webhook) so subscribers can react before the post-call webhook arrives.

payload.initiatorChannelId: string|null (Teros channel that triggered the call)
payload.initiatorAgentId: string|null (Teros agent that triggered the call)

changelog.notes: Description now surfaces the phone-call capability (outbound calls, call transcripts, ConvAI agent config) so agents can discover calling from the app list — previously described as TTS-only
New list-agents tool: discover the account ConvAI agents (id, name, phone numbers assigned) with optional search/limit filtering — no more reading secrets to find an agent ID
Initial release — turn text into natural speech, browse and inspect AI voices, build multi-speaker conversations, and track plan usage
